# NHBS

> > NHBS is a specialized online retailer offering 135,000+ books on wildlife, ecology, and conservation, alongside professional survey equipment and practical tools for field professionals and nature enthusiasts.

NHBS serves as a comprehensive marketplace for the wildlife and conservation community, providing access to academic resources, field guides, specialized equipment, and curated collections. The site supports multiple currencies (GBP, EUR) and languages (English, Deutsch) with international shipping options.

## Key Topics

- Wildlife Survey & Monitoring
- Conservation Equipment
- Field Guides & Natural History
- Academic & Professional Books
- Ecology & Biodiversity
- Species Identification
- International Shipping
- Multi-Currency Support

## Core Shopping Categories

- [Bookstore](https://www.nhbs.com/books): NHBS bookstore with 135,000+ wildlife, ecology & conservation books
- [Equipment Shop](https://www.nhbs.com/equipment): NHBS equipment shop for wildlife survey and conservation tools
- [Wildlife Survey & Monitoring](https://www.nhbs.com/1/wildlife-survey-and-monitoring): Wildlife survey and monitoring equipment category at NHBS
- [Field Guides & Natural History](https://www.nhbs.com/2/field-guides-and-natural-history): Field guides and natural history books for species identification
- [Academic & Professional Books](https://www.nhbs.com/3/academic-and-professional-books): Academic and professional books on biodiversity, ecology & conservation
- [Practical Conservation Equipment](https://www.nhbs.com/4/practical-conservation-equipment): Practical conservation equipment for plant and animal management
- [Magazines](https://www.nhbs.com/magazines): Magazine catalog featuring wildlife, ecology & conservation publications
